# Test fixtures

Synthetic data for unit tests only. These are not real measurements.

- `census_*`: tiny PEP / ACS / Gazetteer samples in the official formats, used by `fetch_census_data.py` offline mode.
- `kwp_export.csv`: a Google Keyword Planner-style export (UTF-16 TSV with two title rows).
- `serp_dfs_organic.json`: a DataForSEO organic SERP response for a fictional city.
- `serp_manual.json`: a hand-recorded SERP audit in the manual template format.
